_readme: Spawn boxes: inside a boxed structure, natural monster spawns come from its pool instead of the biome's list (vanilla
structure spawn_overrides, as on the pillager outpost). Read by patcherMod StructureSpawnBoxes at every world load
(CEConfig [worldgen.systems] spawnBoxes); rejoin after editing. Boxes reach old chunks too. Reference + tests:
feature_writeup/structure_tuning.md, "Spawners and spawn boxes". Pillager spawners are removed from templates
separately (CEConfig removeSpawners).
pools: name -> spawn entries {type, weight, minCount, maxCount} (counts default 1-1). One mob type is picked per
spawn group, so with 1-1 counts the weights are the share of each mob. Only pillagers spawn by day; the other
illagers, ravagers and witches need darkness (their vanilla spawn rules), so by day a mixed box spawns fewer mobs.
boxes: in order; a structure takes the first box that names it. structures / exclude: ids, #tags or namespace:*.
bounding_box: full (the box around the structure, ground and air included) or piece (only inside its pieces;
default). requires_piece: template ids; the box applies only to starts that placed one of them. category: default
monster.
Meta structures: a box on a meta gives its pool to every part that has a box of its own (each part keeps its own
bounding_box and requires_piece). Parts without a box here keep their own spawn_overrides, metas without a box
let every part use its own box.
no_drops: entity -> items its box-spawned mobs never drop (a box respawns forever: no endless totems).
The Mysticrift End tower has its own box (end_tower, the large-tower mix); End illagers and witches get Create diving
gear from kubejs/server_scripts/mobs/end_divers.js (mobs/pillagers #2).
Allay boxes (category creature, pool allay) sit on unboxed mystical structures (mobs/spawns #5). One box per
structure: a structure that already has a monster box can not take an allay box too.
The T&T mushroom fields outpost has no box on purpose: no mobs spawn in mushroom fields (owner, 2026-10-30).
